name: East Group Co.,Ltd
summary: East Group Co.,Ltd is a global enterprise specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of power supply solutions, serving markets both domestically in China and internationally. Its extensive product portfolio includes a variety of Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, such as line interactive, online (transformerless and transformer-based), modular, and outdoor models. Complementing these are essential accessories like interface cards, battery monitoring modules, and their proprietary UPSmart monitoring software. Beyond UPS systems, East Group also supplies power inverters, voltage stabilizers, batteries, and equipment for vehicle charging. They are also active in the solar energy sector, offering off-grid, on-grid, and hybrid photovoltaic (PV) solutions. The company serves a diverse clientele across numerous sectors, including finance, telecommunications, energy, healthcare, manufacturing, and government agencies. Established in 1989, the company, headquartered in Dongguan, China, initially operated as Guangdong East Power Company Ltd. It underwent a name change to East Group Co.,Ltd in September 2015 and currently operates as a subsidiary of Yangzhou Orient Group Co., Ltd.
